# Goodreads

> > Goodreads is the world's largest book discovery and recommendation platform, owned by Amazon, where readers track books, write reviews, and connect with a community of bibliophiles.

Founded by Otis Chandler, Goodreads offers personalized book recommendations, reading challenges, genre browsing, and social features. The platform supports authentication through Amazon, Apple, Google, and Passkey, and hosts diverse content from traditional publishing to fanfiction communities like AO3 (Archive of Our Own).

## Key Topics

- Book discovery and recommendations
- Reading challenges
- Genre browsing (Romance, Fiction, Memoir, Comics)
- User shelves and collections
- New releases and bestsellers
- Fanfiction (AO3/Archive of Our Own)
- Literary quotes
- Author profiles and giveaways
- Social login (Amazon, Apple, Google, Passkey)
- Book reviews and ratings
- Popular authors (Carley Fortune, Abby Jimenez)
- Weekly reading statistics
- Community-curated shelves

## Getting Started

- [Goodreads | Meet your next favorite book](https://goodreads.com): Homepage for Goodreads book discovery and recommendations platform
- [Sign in](https://goodreads.com/user/sign_in): User authentication page with Amazon, Apple, Google login options
- [About Goodreads](https://goodreads.com/about/us): Company overview, mission statement, and founder Otis Chandler's story

## Discover Books

- [Genres](https://goodreads.com/genres): Browse books by genre categories including fiction, memoir, comics
- [Most Read Books This Week In The United States](https://goodreads.com/book/most_read): Weekly most-read book rankings and statistics for United States
- [New Releases Books](https://goodreads.com/shelf/show/new-releases): New releases shelf featuring Abby Jimenez, Carley Fortune, and more
- [Romance Books](https://goodreads.com/genres/romance): Romance genre page with new releases and giveaways from top authors
- [Ao3 Books](https://goodreads.com/shelf/show/ao3): AO3/Archive of Our Own fanfiction books shelf featuring Manacled

## Reading Features

- [Annual Reading Challenge](https://goodreads.com/readingchallenges/annual): Annual reading challenge sign-in with passkey authentication support
- [Popular Quotes](https://goodreads.com/quotes): Most-liked literary quotes from Oscar Wilde, Marilyn Monroe, and others

## Optional

- [Tutorial Books](https://goodreads.com/shelf/show/tutorial): Tutorial shelf with Rust programming, machine learning, and art guides
- [Knitting Stitches Guide](https://goodreads.com/book/show/59849745-knitting-stitches-guide): Beginner knitting tutorial guide by PETTIS GEORGE with stitches basics
- [Introduction to Arduino](https://goodreads.com/book/show/44795042-introduction-to-arduino): Arduino fundamentals tutorial by Christina Bagain with code and pictures
- [How to Draw for Beginners](https://goodreads.com/en/book/show/235745117-how-to-draw-for-beginners---a-complete-step-by-step-guide-from-simple-sh): Drawing workbook by Nora Layne with practice pages and guided videos
- [Drawing Digital](https://goodreads.com/book/show/131339534-drawing-digital): iPad digital art guide by Lisa Bardot for Procreate and drawing apps
- [The New Artist's Guide to Drawing](https://goodreads.com/book/show/195717175-the-new-artist-s-guide-to-drawing): Comprehensive drawing guide by Mark Liam Smith covering multiple subjects
- [The Artist's Complete Guide to Figure Drawing](https://goodreads.com/book/show/574647.The_Artist_s_Complete_Guide_to_Figure_Drawing): Figure drawing guide by Anthony Ryder on classical tradition techniques
